interpretation.hypotheses_not_proven: Insufficient foundation-language learning and narrative-heavy base data are plausible contributors; this experiment does not isolate parameter capacity, data quantity, objective weighting or optimization as the single cause.
interpretation.scope: Result applies to this bounded recipe. Feasibility of an own foundational conversational model below100M parameters is not determined.
interpretation.supported_conclusion: This5.1M model / short foundation exposure /382-conversation SFT recipe failed the response gate. Lower loss did not produce correct conversations.

next_experiment_proposal_only.objective: Establish a foundation-language competence gate before conversation SFT; a2M-target smoke run did not establish it.
steps: Measure a complete eligible base-data pass under a separately frozen token/time plan and a language/coherence development gate.
Retain the accepted teacher curriculum; do not expand conversation volume as a substitute for the base-language check.
Use fresh final cases for any next experiment designed using the outcomes of the current holdout.

resources.disclosure: The one recovery records a fresh system-swap baseline after the stopped process was reaped. This does not erase the first guard breach or claim aggregate swap growth stayed below512MiB.
resources.initial_resource_stop: Global swap grew562.12MiB, exceeding512MiB; original stop preserved.

decoder_parity.scope: Posttraining development prompts only; cache/full/PyTorch inference parity and exact prompt serialization. No optimizer or data/model changes.

stop: Observed development response degeneration stopped updates. The final holdout was scored once for diagnosis, with no subsequent tuning. No scaling or training remains active.
